verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say a connected work inbox lets users send one-to-one emails from the CRM and send sequence emails. The sequences tool sends a series of targeted, timed emails (the snippet is truncated at "[email temp", which points to email templates). Missing for 10: full documentation of email-template creation and use, details on configuring sequence steps and timing, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Connect an individual work email to HubSpot to send one-to-one emails from the CRM, log email replies to the CRM, send sequences emails
